problem: What is the value of $f(t)=[\begin{aligned}\operatorname{ln}⁡(t-4) \\ 5t \\ 1-2t\end{aligned}]$ at $t=5?$
worked_solution:
To evaluate, we substitute $t=5$ into the function, as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}f(5) & =[\begin{aligned}\operatorname{ln}⁡(5-4) \\ 5(5) \\ 1-2(5)\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}\operatorname{ln}⁡1 \\ {5}^{2} \\ 1-10\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 25 \\ -9\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

So the value of $f(t)$ at $t=5$ is the vector $[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 25 \\ -9\end{aligned}].$
